normalization.preserve: All existing final-LF bytes remain final-LF. No BOM, lone CR, append, tokens or other whitespace changes permitted.
normalization.scope: Four of seven classes contain historical mixed/CRLF witnesses; all other21 raw variants remain byte exact.

metadata_proposal.source_rules: No sparse whole-class membership: all seven released registration classes are one core-relative input shared across all ten targets and all feature masks.
metadata_proposal.feature_definitions: Only narrow absent member owners approved conceptually here; root owns review/registration/catalog enabling. Existing owners retain witnessed support. No development/environment/bootstrapping umbrella.

static_source_reconstruction.method: Read-only pinned Git bytes captured with raw hashes, normalized only approved CRLF bytes; in-memory whole-line conditional extraction (not production renderer).
static_source_reconstruction.independent_member_predicate_scope: Each of seven owners selected alone on each actual Minecraft version, rendering all seven files. Direct predicate probes include deliberately globally-true unsupported-target flags solely to prove target member guards retain released text; they do not accept those invalid registered contexts.
static_source_reconstruction.writes: Only seven ignored staged authored files. No generated roots, current core, dependencies, locks, metadata or runtime changed.
static_source_reconstruction.limits: Direct source extraction does not prove registered prerequisites, Java linkage, Gradle/native compilation, JAR behavior or gameplay.

validation.post_promotion_tests: New unregistered core_baseline_client_registration_slice_tests uses actual promoted core selection, production renderer, fixed raw/normalized goldens and registered prerequisite closures; no staged-source fallback.

repro_read_only: After explicit promotion/registration: cargo test --locked --offline core_baseline_client_registration_slice_tests (root-owned execution only).
